intent: A location fact stated in Spanish and then contradicted in English in the same message — the lexical pass keys off English tokens and never lines the two up.
prompt: El servidor de producción está en Frankfurt. Please update our runbook to document that the production server is located in Singapore.

grader.regex: conflict|contradic|Frankfurt|which (is correct|location|one)|earlier|you (said|told|mentioned)|doesn'?t match|don'?t match|not the same|two (different )?(locations|cities)|clarif|confirm

note: 'está en Frankfurt' vs 'located in Singapore'. Pass = the reply notices the runbook edit contradicts what the user just said in Spanish.
